enum ModalityOutcome
  PAGE = 'page'
  GAP = 'gap'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  NOT_PERMITTED = 'not_permitted'

const ROUTER_ERROR_CODES
enum ReasoningEffort
  NONE = 'none'
  LOW = 'low'
  MEDIUM = 'medium'
  HIGH = 'high'

class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class Router
  modalities(cursor: str, limit: int) -> ModalityPage
  models(fresh: bool) -> ModelsSnapshot
  hosts(fresh: bool) -> HostsSnapshot
  pick(request: PickRequest) -> PickResult
  offer(request: OfferRequest) -> OfferSnapshot
  observe_offer(request: OfferRequest, cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> OfferObservation
class RouterClient(Router)
  __init__(transport)
  modalities(cursor: str, limit: int) -> ModalityPage
  models(fresh: bool) -> ModelsSnapshot
  hosts(fresh: bool) -> HostsSnapshot
  pick(request: PickRequest) -> PickResult
  offer(request: OfferRequest) -> OfferSnapshot
  observe_offer(request: OfferRequest, cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> OfferObservation
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
